text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян suddenly stops as we're
walking
back from an outing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Ooo, I smell curry.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: It's just about dinnertime, isn't it?

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. It reminds me of
home. This
smell always came with my
mom shouting that it
was time for dinner.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of, what did your family put
in their
curry?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: Is it different for each family?

text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of, what did your family put
in their
curry?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян
choice_data_list: Is it different for each family?

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Like, my mom used tomato as a
secret
ingredient.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She made it her special ingredient
because my
dad haaates tomatoes!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
My mom's curry is the only thing with
tomatoes in
it that my dad'll eat.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Whenever we had curry for dinner, my
mom and
dad always smiled so happily.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! ♪ That's a good way of putting
it!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. By the way, if you were gonna
have curry...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. By the way, if you were gonna
have curry...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Would you want something you hated in
it? Or
something you liked?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Hehe. You're just like my dad.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'm in the mood for curry now! Let's get
some
ingredients on the way home. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Excuse me!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: What can I do for you, miss?
text_block_list.name: Vegetable Seller

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян and I end up going to the
produce
shop to buy ingredients for
curry.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Will you make me some curry,
Big Bro? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Will you make me some curry,
Big Sis? ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
We've only got so much time before

curfew—hurry up!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yep! ♪ I said I wanted curry—not that I
wanted to
make it! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I guess I wouldn't mind helping
out a bit.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Let's make the taste of happiness
together.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I get that! I'd put something I like
in it too!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I mean, my mom is a good cook. so everything she makes is delicious and looks good to boot... but I get that not everyone can do that. I'm okay with just the things I like!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Sooooo...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Follow me, Big Bro. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Follow me, Big Sis. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Two curries, pleeeaaase! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Okay! Coming right up!
text_block_list.name: Diner Staff

text_block_list.text:
So back to what we were talking about
earlier...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
So back to what we were talking about
earlier...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I think I know the real reason my dad
liked my
mom's curry so much, even
though my mom put
tomatoes in it.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: It was probably because...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Everything tastes better when you eat it
with
someone you love. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Wanna try it? I'm sure if you and I eat
together...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Wanna try it? I'm sure if you and I eat
together...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
The curry here will taste muuuch better
than
usual! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян looks like she loves every
bite as she
devours the curry.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curry Каррен Тян and I make
together is
even more delicious than
usual.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
